sections.heading: C2 — Intersections and interchange layouts
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Intersections and interchange layouts

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A63
A thru-turn intersection manages traffic by prohibiting direct left turns. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A63
For a left turn at a thru-turn intersection, first continue through, use the marked U-turn at the next signal downstream, return toward the intersection and turn right. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A64
A single point urban interchange controls turns from a single signal-controlled point at the interchange center. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A64
At the described single point urban interchange, stop at the stop lines so the vehicle does not extend into cross-traffic. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A64
To go straight through the described single point urban interchange, stay in either of its two through lanes. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A64
To turn left onto the highway at the described single point urban interchange, use the lanes marked for left turns. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A64
The single point urban interchange's exit ramp separates traffic into left-turn and right-turn lanes. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A64
After mistakenly exiting at the described single point urban interchange, do not cross straight to reenter; turn left or right onto the intersecting highway and find a safe turnaround to the correct freeway entrance. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A64
For a right turn after exiting the interstate at the described single point urban interchange, remain in the right lane, yield, turn right, merge and watch for pedestrians. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A65
For a left turn after exiting the interstate at the single point urban interchange, use the left exit lane, merge onto the highway and watch for pedestrians. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A65
The described single point urban interchange provides crosswalks, bicycle paths and pedestrian signals. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A65
Pedestrians and bicyclists at the described single point urban interchange use the signalized crossing and are directed to the central pedestrian island. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A65
A diverging diamond interchange temporarily moves traffic lanes to the highway's left side to provide direct interstate access. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A65
At a diverging diamond interchange, opposing traffic crosses at the signals on either side of the bridge or overpass. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A65
Follow the road signs, signals, raised islands and pavement markings through a diverging diamond interchange. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A65
At a diverging diamond interchange, stop at the stop lines to avoid blocking cross-traffic, pedestrians or bicyclists. [A65]
Source: [A65 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A66
To travel straight through the described diverging diamond interchange, follow the lane to the opposite side at the entrance signal, then through the next signal back to the road's right side. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A66
For the described diverging diamond highway entry, approach in the left lane, follow it through the entrance signal to the opposite side, cross the bridge and turn left onto the highway. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0066]
